summary: Attempt to validate genuine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M streamed inference. The on-disk 7B GGUF is an INCOMPLETE download (2,466,843,849 of ~4,683,074,240 expected bytes; 2,216,230,391 bytes / ~47% missing, including the entire output projection and upper transformer layers). The custom out-of-core streamed backend and all index/plan tools correctly and safely REJECT the truncated file (bounded ~6 MB peak RSS, clean exit 1, 'GGUF tensor range exceeds file length') with no crash, no OOM, no partial/garbage inference. Genuine 7B inference, resident parity, teacher-forced logit comparison and bounded-memory 7B experiments are therefore BLOCKED on the artifact, not on the code. To isolate the blocker to the artifact, the SAME HEAD binary runs genuine streamed greedy inference on the COMPLETE Qwen2.5-1.5B (identical qwen2 decode path) under an enforced 1024 MiB RLIMIT_AS with 62.9 MB peak RSS and coherent output. The 7B's tied/untied output status is determined from its intact header: UNTIED (independent output.weight at Q6_K distinct from token_embd.weight at Q4_K).
classification: PARTIALLY COMPLETE - 7B inference blocked by incomplete model download; backend health, safe-rejection, provenance and untied-output determination verified.

truncation_verdict.method: Independent read-only GGUF parser (python3 -I) walking the KV metadata and full 339-entry tensor table, plus the repo's own CLI validators.
truncation_verdict.expected_full_size_note: ~4.683 GB is the canonical size of an imatrix Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF; the present file is ~52.7% of that.
truncation_verdict.conclusion: INCOMPLETE / TRUNCATED DOWNLOAD. The GGUF header (metadata + tensor table) is intact and fully parseable, but ~47% of the tensor payload is absent.

untied_output_determination.result: UNTIED (independent output projection present in header)
untied_output_determination.evidence: A distinct output.weight tensor exists with a DIFFERENT quant type (Q6_K) than token_embd.weight (Q4_K); distinct type proves these are not the same (tied) tensor. This matches the common pattern for 7B-class models.
untied_output_determination.executable_caveat: output.weight begins at absolute offset ~3.452 GB, which is INSIDE the missing/truncated region. The untied projection therefore CANNOT be executed or numerically validated from this artifact. Determination is header-only.

io_amplification_10_tokens.interpretation: Per-token full-weight re-streaming. ~2.74 GB source read per generated token for a 986 MB model. Extrapolated to the complete 4.68 GB 7B this implies on the order of ~4.7 GB source read per token before caching.

backend_health_complete_model.bounded_memory_conclusion: Complete qwen2 1.5B runs correctly under an enforced 1024 MiB RLIMIT_AS at 62.9 MB peak RSS. WSL2 RLIMIT_AS is NOT a claim about physical 2 GB RAM hardware.

observations.broken_pipe_exit_101: Piping the CLI's stdout/stderr into `head -N` closes the pipe early and produces a Rust broken-pipe (EPIPE) panic, exit 101. This is a benign CLI-consumer artifact (standard Rust SIGPIPE=SIG_IGN behavior), NOT an inference failure: draining the output (e.g. `tail`) yields exit 0 with full correct generation. No model/FFI defect; no code change made (code is correct).
observations.resident_backend_with_sha256: `chat --backend resident --sha256 ...` errors with 'verification requires streamed backend with verification-mb in 1..64'. Expected: in-flight SHA verification is a streamed-backend feature. Not a defect.
